A network.
Three useful behaviours.

Physical structure, flow and recovery — considered together.

At rest

Structure

Interconnected fibrils form a physical network in water.

Under shear

Flow

The network flows more easily during mixing, pumping and application.

After shear

Recovery

Once shear falls, physical structure can rebuild.

Current rheology characterization supports viscoelastic behaviour, shear thinning and post-shear recovery. Evaluate performance in your finished formulation.
